result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

BBL DEMON — PROBLEM ENERGY.
Preserve the exact illustrated adult demon woman: long flowing black hair, red eyes, two red curved horns, silver hoop earrings, black fitted top, cropped red/black varsity jacket with flame/demon pattern, red cargo trousers with chains and black buckled platform boots. Her existing crimson-purple aura is foreground magic, never an opaque background. Confident theatrical attitude, no sexualized camera framing or costume changes.
0–1.2s: full-body slow confident stance; she rolls a tiny red-violet flame between two fingertips and raises one eyebrow as if deciding how much trouble to cause.
1.2–3.2s: she drops the flame and stamps a boot onto a finite floating red sigil. THREE gigantic jagged infernal halos tear open behind her in sequence, linked by curling black-red flame ribbons. Camera pulls rapidly far back and tilts upward to show their outrageous scale while leaving cyan visible through and around them; no scenery or solid background.
3.2–4.8s: she casually snaps her fingers. The halos collide into an enormous horned theatrical-mask emblem split between a grin and a scowl, then erupt in layered red-gold shockwaves and sharp black ink petals. Her full silhouette stands untouched at the center with hair and jacket flaring. Localized impact core and brief heavy hold; no actual people harmed.
4.8–6s: camera SNAP-PUSHES into her face and shoulders as exact title "PROBLEM ENERGY" slams into two bold comic lines, matching the last shockwave. She gives a knowing smirk.
6–8s: camera eases into a clear three-quarter hero pose. She inspects one fingernail while the enormous emblem collapses back into a tiny flame on her fingertip; she casually flicks that last spark away. Title holds, hair settles. Sound: fingertip crackle, deep rising ignition, three colossal halo rips, explosive emblem collision, title slam, tiny final spark snap. No spoken catchphrase or music.
